title: Pankeki original pancake motion demo
creator: Original vector artwork authored by Codex for the Pankeki project
license: CC0-1.0 (artwork only; application modules retain their licenses)
method: Manually authored SVG shapes and existing Chrome Canvas rasterization. No Image Gen, external assets, downloaded model, inference, prerecorded animation, or rectangular stand-in fixture.
manualPreparation: Body contains syrup, butter, cheeks and limbs but no eyes or mouth.
Eyes and mouth are separate RGBA PNG materials. Background is a separately drawn clean breakfast nook.
Source is composed from actual PNG layers at the default pose; it is reference-only and is not used as an overdraw background.

Eye closed key compresses to 6.16px height, never zero-area. Mouth interior uses an ordinary 68x36 material-size grid, a normal part scaleY of 8/36, and valid keys that produce 8px default and 40px open height.
Breath uses 1.8% horizontal and 2.5% vertical body displacement; eye and mouth layers have matching small vertical displacement.
Mesh/keyforms/parents/curves are manually prepared and use the same document parser, controller, renderer and exporter as user PNG parts.
sourceInvariant: Original PNG bytes and UV/topology are never rewritten by parameters. The app validates references, geometry and hashes before accepting poses.
